review.summary: Independent review found no net loss or added obligation. All behavioral segments are carried locally or through required shared policies; the dropped schema version, lifecycle status, legacy alias, and introduction version are non-behavioral provenance. External-link and docs/dist/** exceptions, strict severity/disposition, verdict mappings, reporting requirements, and anti-patterns survive. Render success and reference resolution remain jointly mandatory through mutual requires edges, and both require the COULD_NOT_CHECK part. Both original relationships are sensibly remapped, and the source alias resolves to all three parts.
